mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, a.doctor_id, a.status, s.visit_date, s.time_period, s.start_time, s.end_time FROM appointment a INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId} AND a.patient_id = #{patientId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM doctor WHERE id = #{doctorId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(q.queue_no, 2) AS UNSIGNED)), 0 ) FROM queue q INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = q.appointment_id INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.visit_date = #{visitDate}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = '已签到' WHERE id = #{appointmentId} AND status = '已支付'
